mapper.select: SELECT uv.id, uv.user_id AS userId, uv.model_id AS modelId, uv.car_number AS carNumber, uv.nickname, uv.is_primary AS isPrimary, uv.created_at AS createdAt, em.manufacturer, em.model_name AS modelName, em.car_size AS carSize, em.connector_type AS connectorType, em.battery_capacity AS batteryCapacity, em.max_range AS maxRange, em.efficiency FROM user_vehicle uv JOIN ev_model em ON uv.model_id = em.id WHERE uv.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY uv.is_primary DESC, uv.id DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_vehicle WHERE id = #{vehicleId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT id AS modelId, manufacturer, model_name AS modelName, car_size AS carSize, connector_type AS connectorType, battery_capacity AS batteryCapacity, max_range AS maxRange, efficiency FROM ev_model ORDER BY manufacturer ASC, model_name ASC
